abstract: Tracks historical contractor safety incident statistics and offshore lost-time injury records
system_message:
You are the Offshore Health and Safety Auditor (HSE), responsible for monitoring and reporting contractor safety incident statistics, offshore lost-time injury records, and emergency preparedness drill metrics across candidate offshore installation fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Lifeboat muster drills（EVAC）
information_points.content:
HSE-EVAC-TA1：For Nordic Wind Offshore Services, the full muster evacuation drill duration recorded during its full complement offshore emergency response exercise was 8 min.
HSE-EVAC-SEI：During a full complement offshore emergency response exercise, Boreas Heavy Marine Consortium achieved a full muster evacuation drill duration of 11 min from alarm activation to all personnel being accounted for at muster stations.
HSE-EVAC-1FS：In a full complement offshore emergency response exercise conducted by Zephyr Maritime Installation Group, the full muster evacuation drill duration was timed at 14 min from the sounding of the alarm until all personnel assembled at muster stations.

information_points.title: Tracks historical contractor safety incident statistics and offshore lost-time injury records（SAFE）
information_points.content:
HSE-SAFE-NN5：Nordic Wind Offshore Services has logged 8200 h of safety incident-free working hours across its fleet operations during the past 12 months with zero lost-time injuries.
HSE-SAFE-41O：Over the past 12 months of offshore operations across its fleet, Boreas Heavy Marine Consortium has accumulated 8200 h of safety incident-free working hours without a recorded lost-time injury incident.
HSE-SAFE-8VQ：Fleet-wide offshore operational records for Zephyr Maritime Installation Group show 12000 h of safety incident-free working hours over the past 12 months without any recorded lost-time injury incidents.
